description: This file is a unit test class for Search installation setup, extending a base SearchTestAbstract class. It verifies the presence of 'search' configuration settings such as 'controller' and 'defaultEngine' within the global $sugar_config array.

classes.name: SearchInstallTest
classes.description: A unit test class that checks the proper configuration of the search feature during installation, ensuring 'search' parameters are set in the global configuration.

methods.name: testConfiguredSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests that the 'search' configuration exists within the global $sugar_config array and contains 'controller' and 'defaultEngine' keys.
